proximity.anchor: Each recipient s retained normal base groups; never transferred groups
proximity.normalizer: Maximum pairwise GPS distance among all23 combined groups
proximity.aggregation: Mean normalized distance across23 current owners in each phase

load.points: Sum each combined group score once for its current owner
load.n: Custodians available during this phase, excluding their own lunches

dayScore: Duration-weighted mean of (0.75*proximityLoss + 0.25*loadLoss) over exact static shift and lunch boundaries
gpsInput: Authoritative active group coordinates with source/confidence metadata; no inferred coordinates or pixel-anchor substitution
currentGpsReadback: All23 groups have exact ID-bound saved coordinates:22 group pins and the stored Cat Country member centroid. Coordinates are not physically qualified walking routes.
request: Single asynchronous Main question asking whether to use this normalization or a different formula
